confidence_notes: Food anchors use Dahab cost-of-living prices, though the local panel is small and Egyptian-pound prices can shift. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on the supplied Cairo and Sharm El Sheikh comparisons. Cocktail prices use a reported Dahab range; wine is estimated from its relationship to local beer prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Dahab’s backpacker and beach-town market suggests lower dorm and private-room prices than Sharm El Sheikh, close to Cairo’s hostel prices. Basic rooms should be nearer Cairo’s guesthouse level, while three-star rooms fall between Cairo and Sharm El Sheikh.
